method_or_threshold_if_reported: Surgical resection or endoscopic biopsy; matched normal gastric tissue was sampled several centimeters from tumor; peritoneal metastasis was sampled during diagnostic laparoscopy.
evidence_location: Methods: Sample Acquisition and Tissue Processing
matrix_content_effect: Defines tissue source and sampling context.
unresolved_detail: Exact ischemia time and time from collection to dissociation were not reported.
implication_for_downstream_plan: Retain verified tissue and patient grouping and inspect sample-specific stress effects.
requires_special_handling: Do not infer pairing beyond GEO-to-manuscript patient mapping.

method_or_threshold_if_reported: Tissues were placed in MACS tissue storage buffer immediately after collection and kept on ice.
evidence_location: Methods: Sample Acquisition and Tissue Processing
matrix_content_effect: Cold storage can influence stress and viability signals.
implication_for_downstream_plan: Inspect dissociation and stress signatures by sample during F1 cluster QC.
requires_special_handling: Do not interpret stress-dominant clusters as new biology without sample-aware review.

method_or_threshold_if_reported: Human Tumor Dissociation Kit plus GentleMACS Octodissociator 37_h_TDK_2; 70-um straining; 5-minute RBC lysis; PBS neutralization; two PBS plus 1% BSA washes; final 40-um straining.
evidence_location: Methods: Sample Acquisition and Tissue Processing
matrix_content_effect: Can create lineage-dependent recovery and dissociation-stress bias.
unresolved_detail: No sample-specific dissociation yield or stress measurement was reported.
implication_for_downstream_plan: F1 must inspect FOS/JUN/HSP stress, lineage recovery, hemoglobin signal and sample dominance.
requires_special_handling: Do not treat observed cell proportions as unbiased tissue composition.

method_or_threshold_if_reported: Live cells were counted manually with 1:1 trypan blue and concentrated to 800-1200 live cells/uL.
evidence_location: Methods: Sample Acquisition and Tissue Processing
matrix_content_effect: Enriches the input for viable cells before droplet capture.
unresolved_detail: No FACS viability gate, dead-cell removal kit, viability percentage or excluded-cell list was reported.
implication_for_downstream_plan: Use mitochondrial, hemoglobin and low-feature metrics as residual quality evidence rather than assuming perfect viability selection.
requires_special_handling: Unknown wet-lab exclusions must remain explicit.

method_or_threshold_if_reported: Samples from each patient were processed in one library-preparation batch using the 10x Chromium Single-Cell 5-prime Library and Gel Bead Kit.
matrix_content_effect: Defines droplet-based 5-prime chemistry and a patient-linked batch structure.
unresolved_detail: Exact kit revision, chemistry release, target loading and recovered-cell target were not reported.
implication_for_downstream_plan: Treat sample_id or patient_id as the operative batch unit unless stronger metadata become available.
requires_special_handling: Expected doublet rate cannot be reconstructed from loading information.

method_or_threshold_if_reported: Indexed libraries were quantified with a Kapa library kit and sequenced on Illumina HiSeq4000.
matrix_content_effect: Defines the sequencing platform upstream of FASTQ generation.
unresolved_detail: Read structure, read length, per-sample depth and sequencing QC were not reported in the reviewed sources.
implication_for_downstream_plan: Do not claim read-level QC or depth harmonization from the public matrices.
requires_special_handling: FASTQ-level technical covariates are not evaluable.

method_or_threshold_if_reported: Cell Ranger v3.0 aligned FASTQ reads to the hg38 reference transcriptome and generated per-sample single-cell feature counts.
evidence_location: Original paper Methods and GEO Sample_data_processing
matrix_content_effect: Produces the integer feature-by-cell counts supplied downstream.
unresolved_detail: Exact hg38 reference package release and Cell Ranger command-line parameters were not reported.
implication_for_downstream_plan: Use the public counts as author-generated counts; do not claim Cell Ranger reproduction.
requires_special_handling: Gene annotation and cell-calling uncertainty must be recorded.

method_or_threshold_if_reported: Cell Ranger cell-calling inputs and thresholds, expected-cells or force-cells settings, chemistry override and filtered-versus-raw feature-matrix choice were not reported.
evidence_location: Original paper Methods and GEO processing/availability fields
matrix_content_effect: Determines which droplets were called as cells before Seurat filtering.
unresolved_detail: No raw or empty-droplet matrix, Cell Ranger web summary or called-cell barcode list is public.
implication_for_downstream_plan: F1 can assess retained public cells only; true barcode knee, Cell Ranger cell calling and empty-droplet composition are not evaluable.
requires_special_handling: Record emptyDrops, SoupX and CellBender as not_evaluable_input_limited; absent droplets cannot be reconstructed.

method_or_threshold_if_reported: Seurat v3; each sample was considered for genes/features shared by at least 3 cells; retain cells with 500 or more and fewer than 6000 detected features; remove cells with mitochondrial percentage above 20.
evidence_location: Original paper Bioinformatic QC section and GEO Sample_data_processing
matrix_content_effect: Removes low-feature, high-feature and high-mitochondrial cells and filters the author's per-sample analysis feature space.
unresolved_detail: Per-step and per-sample removed-cell counts, barcode lists and exact feature-space calculation order were not reported.
implication_for_downstream_plan: F0 recomputes one per-sample min.cells=3 working feature space to measure fixed-QC effects; F1 uses the same feature-space definition for QC/object construction while preserving all 26,571 archived rows in the immutable input and applying method-specific coverage rules downstream.
requires_special_handling: Reported thresholds are a baseline, not permission to skip residual QC, permanently delete low-detection genes or assume the public feature rows equal the author analysis feature space.

method_or_threshold_if_reported: GEO supplementary files are sample-wise matrices containing raw gene counts for every supplied gene and cell.
matrix_content_effect: Defines the local project input as raw gene counts rather than normalized expression.
unresolved_detail: The exact export command and whether export occurred before or after DoubletFinder were not reported.
implication_for_downstream_plan: Preserve counts unchanged as the F1 raw-count layer and audit the export boundary separately.
requires_special_handling: Do not import author SCTransform or integrated values as if they were present in the CSV files.

method_or_threshold_if_reported: FASTQ and raw files were not submitted for patient-privacy reasons; no public SRA runs were found for PRJNA762312 in the current audit.
matrix_content_effect: Prevents read-level reprocessing, barcode-knee/cell-calling assessment and empty-droplet background reconstruction.
unresolved_detail: BCL, FASTQ, BAM, raw feature-barcode matrices and Cell Ranger outputs are unavailable.
implication_for_downstream_plan: Use public called/retained-cell raw-count matrices for independent re-QC with explicit provenance limits.
requires_special_handling: No FASTQ/Cell Ranger reproduction claim; emptyDrops, SoupX and CellBender are not evaluable from current inputs.

method_or_threshold_if_reported: DoubletFinder was used on gene-expression data and identified doublets were removed from the author's analysis data set.
evidence_location: Methods: Doublet Analysis and Figure 1 legend
matrix_content_effect: Removes predicted multiplets from the author's final analysis object.
unresolved_detail: DoubletFinder version, pN, pK, nExp, homotypic adjustment, per-sample versus merged execution, timing, counts and barcode list were not reported; public CSV doublet status is unresolved.
implication_for_downstream_plan: F1 must run preregistered per-sample scDblFinder and retain DoubletFinder only as sensitivity review.
requires_special_handling: Do not assume the public matrices are already doublet-clean or target the paper final cell count.

method_or_threshold_if_reported: No SoupX, DecontX, CellBender or other ambient-RNA correction was reported in the reviewed original-paper methods, GEO processing fields or official supplementary workbook.
evidence_location: Original paper Methods, GEO processing fields and official supplementary workbook
matrix_content_effect: If absent, ambient transcripts may remain in retained-cell counts.
unresolved_detail: Absence of reporting does not prove correction was not performed; raw background droplets are unavailable.
implication_for_downstream_plan: F1 must estimate cross-lineage contamination and DecontX feasibility from retained cells.
requires_special_handling: Keep original counts; corrected counts require a separate layer and approval.

method_or_threshold_if_reported: SCTransform was run separately for each sample with mitochondrial RNA percentage regressed.
evidence_location: Methods: Bioinformatic QC, Normalization, Clustering, and Differential Gene Expression
matrix_content_effect: Affected the author's normalized analysis object, not the integer values in the public raw-count CSV files.
unresolved_detail: Exact SCTransform version and full parameters were not reported.
implication_for_downstream_plan: Treat this only as author-analysis context; select F1 normalization from project goals and observed data.
requires_special_handling: Do not assume the public CSV files are SCTransformed or inherit author regression.

method_or_threshold_if_reported: An 18-sample high-cell-number reference spanning primary and peritoneal characteristics was used for anchor finding; remaining samples were integrated as queries with PrepSCTIntegration and FindIntegrationAnchors.
evidence_location: Methods: Bioinformatic QC, Normalization, Clustering, and Differential Gene Expression
matrix_content_effect: Affected the author's integrated embedding and clustering, not the public raw-count values.
unresolved_detail: The identities of all 18 reference samples and complete integration parameters were not reported in the reviewed sources.
implication_for_downstream_plan: F1 must use the approved project integration plan and independently assess biological conservation and batch removal.
requires_special_handling: Author integration is reference context, not a preprocessing fact inherited by local counts.

method_or_threshold_if_reported: Integrated data were scaled, reduced by PCA/UMAP and clustered with SNN resolution 1; FindAllMarkers and literature markers were used for annotation, with a greater-than-25-percent expression rule for cluster markers.
evidence_location: Methods: Bioinformatic QC, Normalization, Clustering, and Differential Gene Expression
matrix_content_effect: Defines the author's final analysis object and labels but does not alter public raw-count values.
unresolved_detail: No public cell-level author cluster or annotation table is present in the current project inputs.
implication_for_downstream_plan: F1 must cluster and annotate independently and may compare author labels only if later supplied.
requires_special_handling: Do not treat author clusters as already embedded in the CSV matrices.

method_or_threshold_if_reported: No author analysis repository, executable pipeline, cell-level metadata, excluded-barcode list or stepwise per-sample cell-count table was located in the original article, GEO record or official supplementary data collection reviewed for F0.
evidence_location: Data availability sections and official supplementary collection
matrix_content_effect: Prevents exact reconstruction of each author exclusion and the public export command.
unresolved_detail: Unreported material may exist outside the reviewed official sources.
implication_for_downstream_plan: Record all F1 exclusions de novo with barcodes, reasons and before/after counts.
requires_special_handling: Do not claim exact reproduction of the author's final object.
